ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager has been worried for days and keeps turning a smooth stone: offer to listen, or find a match.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has been worried about something for days. (subject.He/She) won't say what, and that's (subject.his/her) business. But (subject.he/she) keeps turning a smooth little stone over and over in (subject.his/her) fingers. Today (friend) notices.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "You don't have to tell me anything," says (friend). "But if you ever want to, I'm here." (subject) nods, and keeps turning the stone. (subject.He/She) doesn't say anything that day. But the next morning there's a little flower on (friend)'s doorstep, and (subject) is humming.

b__fx.name: Answer B
b__fx.text: (friend) spends the afternoon on the beach and comes back with a stone that's almost exactly the same. "For when one isn't enough," (friend.he/she) says. (subject) laughs for the first time in days. The worry is still there. It just feels a little smaller with two stones.
